query: INSERT INTO read_states (user_id, channel_id, last_read_message_id, mention_count) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4) ON CONFLICT (user_id, channel_id) DO UPDATE SET last_read_message_id = EXCLUDED.last_read_message_id, mention_count = EXCLUDED.mention_count, updated_at = NOW() RETURNING channel_id, last_read_message_id, mention_count, muted
